components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview: VidAI's interface is carved like Mughal pietra dura: a calm ivory-marble ground, panels inlaid with rose stone, jali lattice screens as section dividers, and gold hairlines drawing the borders. Headlines are set in Playfair Display like engraved cartouches; everything operational is Outfit — quiet, precise, tabular where numbers mean money. The rose accent is the inlay: it marks every primary action and every number a couple cares about, and its rarity is what keeps it precious.
keyCharacteristics: Jali lattice (authored 8-point-star SVG) as divider strips and quiet panel texture — never behind body text
Arch-topped frames for the product's signature surfaces
Gold hairline rules with a diamond center between sections
Rose #d7385e reserved for inlay accents; interactive rose is #a92747 for AA contrast
One authored motion: the hero assistant types its own exchange

rules.name: The Inlay Rule
rules.body: The bright rose #d7385e never renders as body text or a fill under white body text; interactive rose is always Rose Deep #a92747.

rules.name: The PKR Rule
rules.body: Money is always ₨ + toLocaleString('en-PK') with tabular numerals; never a bare number.

rules.name: The Lattice Rule
rules.body: Jali patterns sit behind headings, empty states and side panels — never behind paragraphs a user reads.

rules.name: The Cartouche Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display never sets UI controls, labels, or table body text — it announces; Outfit operates.

rules.name: The Tint Ladder Rule
rules.body: Reach for a stone-tinted panel before a shadow; shadows respond to state, they don't fake hierarchy.

rules.name: The No-Nesting Rule
rules.body: Content sits directly on tinted panels — never a white card inside a tinted card.

dos: Do use Rose Deep (#a92747) for every interactive rose and Rose (#d7385e) only for display accents.
Do set money as ₨ + tabular numerals, always.
Do keep one authored motion per surface with cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1).
donts: Don't nest a white card inside a tinted/jali panel.
Don't put jali texture behind paragraphs, or Playfair on controls and labels.
Don't use progress rings, sparklines, gradient text, or icon-card grids as page structure.
